questions.question: What did Eliphaz claim about the innocent?
options: Even the upright are swept away in the wrath of God
The innocent suffer just as much as all of the guilty
No one on the whole wide earth is truly innocent before God
The innocent do not perish; the upright are not cut off
questions.answer: The innocent do not perish; the upright are not cut off
